GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well pushing on Wide out shared lead Two Wide (1000m), kept the pressure right on To The Turn , Straightened Up Quickly Under Pressure & Beaten , faded out of it # poor recovery
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Weakened approaching the home turn. A post-race vet exam revealed a poor recovery.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped best and Went Forward to lead Two Wide by 0.75 Lengths , Held Together in front & led Two Wide same margin turning, got away rounding turn then kept increasing margin down the running. [Stewards: Post-race vet exam revealed it to be displaying signs of colic.] # bolted in
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race vet exam revealed signs of colic.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , sat on Leaders heels 1 Lengths 800m, No Match when Leader sprinted before the corner but he held on for second spot # brave chase
Jumped okay & Went Forward to Two Wide joint Lead settling down, Headed 900m and held together much same to turn then shifted out to 1 length 3 Wide , Lost Ground in Straight # no excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly leaving the 1000m. Shifted out and bumped near the 900m. Laid out under pressure in the early stages of the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped very awkwardly and Settled Down 2 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 4.5 Lengths rail turning, Lost Ground in straight. First start: Need to see again. # no real excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began very awkwardly, shifted out and bumped.
